'''Volume 3: Abra & Kadabra Magic''' is the third of ten volumes of the [[Magical Pokémon Journey]] manga created by [[Yumi Tsukirino]].

==Blurb==
''Ninjas, Psychics, and Magic!''
* The Ninja boy Wal is trying his best to impress his teacher, the greatest ninja of them all—Ditto!
* Almond and Squirtle go on one of the most harrowing adventures of them all! They try to follow Jigglypuff!
* A psychic Abra is the only one who can find a hidden sweet potato to win Wal the fabulous sweet-potato prize!
* Kadabra uses its amazing powers to help the Pokémon find Hazel's missing picture of Almond!
* These stories and many, many more!

==Important events==
* [[Walnut]] and [[Master Ditto]] are introduced.
* [[Hazel]] and {{TP|Hazel|Pikachu}} celebrate the anniversary of their first meeting.
* The cast celebrates its second [[Christmas]].

==Trivia==
* This volume contains two "Bonus Bonus" chapters:
** Yumi Tsukirino's "How I Got Through Hey You, Pikachu!": Tsukirino discusses her frustration playing [[Hey You, Pikachu!]] and apologizes for falling behind in answering fan mail.
** Japanese Folk Tales <s>Revised</s> Revisited: Three short parodies of folktales featuring characters from [[Magical Pokémon Journey]].
* At the end of the book, there is a joke advertisement for {{Vol|Magical Pokémon Journey|4}} teasing that a [[Pistachio|notorious jewel thief]] and his {{TP|Pistachio|Bulbasaur}} will come after Hazel and her "legendary" gem.
